story.wedding_date: May 31th, 2025 Quinta Nova do Hespanhol, PORTUGAL
story.invitation: We invited you to celebrate our wedding
story.groom_description: Born and raised in Barreiro – the hidden gem of the Age of Discoveries! While others praise Lisbon and Porto, we in Barreiro know the real magic happened here, with salt, shipbuilding, and, well, ME! In 2016, I packed my bags and headed to Paris. In May 2017, I discovered something even better than new continents: Catarina!
story.bride_description: Born in Lisbon, has more miles than Miguel! From an early age, she’s been exploring the world like a true "explorer," living in places as diverse as Belgium, Portugal, the Saudi Arabia, South Korea, and of course, France. If Portugal was a pioneer in the Age of Discoveries, she definitely followed in those footsteps — only she traded the caravels for airplanes!
story.our_story_description: We didn’t need compasses to find each other... just an app!
story.dating_anniversary_description: After a really fun first date, we decided to go for a second one, this time at an Ethiopian restaurant that Catarina had heard about. The atmosphere was great, the food was amazing.
story.proposal_description: For the marriage proposal, Miguel took advantage of our trip to Greece and proposed to Catarina after reading a poem by Vinicius de Moraes called "Soneto de fidelidade" on a dark beach, illuminated only by the lights of the boats.
